messages:
maya: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we've got three remediation tracks for the streaming/chat reliability issues (timeouts, partial responses, reconnect handling). I'll drop owners and proposed timelines here.

liam: thanks — want to confirm ownership and whether we need a hotfix or just config/app changes?

maya: For immediate mitigation: runtime-level backoff + client reconnect tolerances (hotfix, 48h). Medium term: server-side partial-response detection + gapless resume (2 weeks). Long term: automated replay + regression tests in CI (4w).

sara: timeline sounds reasonable. i'm happy to own product-side acceptance criteria & QA.

nico: i'll take server-side partial-response detection. plan: add an endpoint health check that validates KV cache resume behavior and a histogram for partial-chunk sizes. ETA 10 business days.

liam: i'll do the hotfix for client reconnect behavior. patch will: increase client-side jittered backoff, limit concurrent reconnect attempts per session, and add a short-lived token to dedupe resumed streams. ETA 48h.

maya: action items (concise):
- liam: hotfix PR + canary (48h)
- nico: partial-response detector & metrics (10bd)
- sara: acceptance tests + runbook updates (7bd)
- maya: rollout policy + SLA impact memo (3bd)

liam: quick note on the hotfix — prototype reconnect snippet: `if (reconnects > 3) wait = min(10s, 2**reconnects + jitter)`

nico: posting rough check logic:```
// on tokenized stream chunk receipt
if (chunk.size == 0 || !chunk.has_eom && time_since_last_chunk > 2s) {
  emit_metric('partial_chunk_detected', 1)
  mark_session_for_resume(session_id)
}
```

sara: runbook additions:
- Triage playbook: how to distinguish client timeouts vs server-side stalls
- Pager rules: escalate to runtime on >3 partial responses/5m across a customer
- Customer comms template

maya: recurring pattern analysis: looks like spikes correlate with 99th-pct token-latency jumps during occasional batch build failures. we should add a daily job to scan for these spike patterns and tag model-version+hardware combos.

liam: agree. I'll add a Prometheus alert for 99p token latency > 2s sustained for 1m and link to the incident runbook.

nico: also proposing a synthetic test that streams a long prompt every hour to catch regressions in reconnect/caching. keeps KV cache warmed.

anita-bot: created ticket RF-3172: "Streaming reconnect hotfix" (owner: liam, due: 48h).
anita-bot: created ticket RF-3173: "Partial response detector + metrics" (owner: nico, due: 10bd).
anita-bot: created ticket RF-3174: "Runbook + acceptance tests" (owner: sara, due: 7bd).

sara: adding acceptance items: verify no user-visible duplicate chunks, resume preserves KV state, and latency regressions <5% vs baseline for typical prompts.

maya: can each owner drop a PR link in this thread when opened? we'll have a 1wk checkpoint sync next Tuesday.

liam: will do. starting work now — ping me if you want to pair on the canary config. :thumbsup:

nico: copying infra for the synthetic test — will post the script and metrics dashboard prototype in #eng-runtime by end of day.

sara: adding the customer comms draft to the runbook PR once liam's canary shows stability.

maya: thanks all — capturing this as the authoritative follow-up. if anything slips, call it out here and we'll reassign.

anita-bot: scheduled reminder: follow-up checkpoint meeting in 7 days (1809999999).
